tasks.completion_summary: Implemented MCP sampling/createMessage handler — SDK client registration, CLI --sampling-stub/--sampling-stub-file flags, TUI overlay screen with manual/canned/abort options, and full SDK round-trip integration tests.

Extended sampling support to CreateMessageWithTools (SDK v1.6.0): added WithToolsHandler interface, NewToolUseStubHandler with ParseToolUseSpec, --sampling-tool-use CLI flag, TUI tool-pick mode with cursor navigation, and end-to-end round-trip integration tests including tool_result follow-up.

Implemented MCP roots/list capability: new internal/mcp/roots package with ParseFlag (name=path) and LoadFile parsers, service-level SetInitialRoots/AddRoots/RemoveRoots/ListRoots wiring through SDK client.AddRoots/RemoveRoots, repeatable --root and --roots-file CLI flags, TUI roots-editor overlay accessible via 'R' from both connection and main screens with staging adapter for pre-connect edits, and end-to-end integration tests verifying roots/list visibility and roots/list_changed notification dispatch on the wire. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything's get-roots-list tool.

Implemented client-side OAuth in new internal/mcp/oauth package: Handler dispatches to SDK's auth.AuthorizationCodeHandler (RFC 6749 §4.1 + RFC 7636 PKCE) or extauth.ClientCredentialsHandler (RFC 6749 §4.4) based on Config.Mode(); LocalServerFetcher binds an ephemeral loopback listener for the auth-code redirect with auto-discovery via PRM (RFC 9728) and ASM (RFC 8414); FileTokenCache persists tokens to platform-default cache dirs (XDG/Library/LOCALAPPDATA) with mode 0600 atomic writes; service.Connect plumbs OAuthHandler into StreamableClientTransport when ConnectionConfig.OAuth is set; new --oauth-client-id/--oauth-client-secret/--oauth-token-url/--oauth-scopes/--oauth-redirect-{host,port}/--oauth-dynamic-registration/--oauth-cache CLI flags shared by CLI and TUI launchers; TUI status indicator with color-coded state and 'A' Re-authenticate keybinding; mock OAuth server (handles /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, /token, /authorize, /register) drives 23 tests covering client-credentials, auth-code+PKCE, DCR (RFC 7591), bad-secret rejection, OAuth error redirect, file cache round-trip/expiry/mode, scope dedup, and service wiring. OS keychain native bindings deferred to a follow-up per task size_note — file fallback fully covers the acceptance criterion.

Implemented Tier 2 capability inspector (SEP-2133 extensions): new internal/mcp/capabilities package with Snapshot type and FromInitializeResult/DeriveClientCapabilities pure functions; service.GetCapabilitiesSnapshot interface method capturing both server InitializeResult and derived client capabilities at connect time; new Capabilities tab (5th) in Ctrl+D debug overlay with snapshot-provider closure pattern, full server+client rendering including extensions/experimental maps, y/c-to-copy JSON action, and nil-safe wiring across main/tool/connection callers; new mcp-tui capabilities CLI subcommand emitting indented deterministic JSON (sorted keys at every level via map round-trip); 25 new tests covering rendering, JSON marshaling, deterministic ordering, omitempty for absent caps, nil-snapshot empty state, 5-tab navigation arithmetic, integration via real SDK Connect handshake, and CLI happy-path with stdout capture. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: emits valid JSON with 2025-11-25 protocol, all server caps + instructions, and clientCaps.roots.listChanged.

Implemented Tier 2 negotiated-protocol-version surfacing across TUI status bar, CLI debug output, and saved-connections persistence: new formatConnectedStatus helper renders 'Connected to <target> [MCP <version>]' from ms.mcpService.GetServerInfo().ProtocolVersion in handleConnectionSuccess (HTTP/SSE branch fixed to use URL instead of empty command); new printNegotiatedVersion in internal/cli/base.go fires '🔖 Negotiated MCP <version>' to stderr when --debug is set (registered the previously-unregistered --debug PersistentFlag in main.go that was being read but never declared); new ConnectionEntry.LastSeenVersion field with omitempty + new ConnectionsManager.UpdateLastUsedWithVersion method that preserves prior version on transient failure; SetConnectionSuccessHook on MainScreen lets the connection screen and auto-connect manager.go closure-wire UpdateLastUsedWithVersion to the negotiated version without coupling MainScreen to the models package; 14 new tests covering: ProtocolVersion extraction across 5 spec versions in capabilities, formatConnectedStatus for stdio/HTTP/no-version, hook firing + nil-safety in MainScreen.handleConnectionSuccess, UpdateLastUsedWithVersion happy-path + empty-version-preserves-prior + JSON round-trip + omitempty, printNegotiatedVersion with-debug/no-debug/no-version/nil-service. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: stderr now shows '🔖 Negotiated MCP 2025-11-25' under --debug.

Implemented Tier 2 notification stream pane: new internal/mcp/notifications package with thread-safe ring-buffer Stream (default cap 500), Type/Level constants, FromMethod method-name lookup, FromRequest+describeParams translator that reads typed SDK params for all 7 notification kinds (message, progress, resources/updated, tools|prompts|resources/list_changed, cancelled), Filter struct with HasTypes/AllowType/AllowLevel/Allow + FilterEntries pure function, and Entry.FormatLine/FormatJSON for unified TUI+CLI rendering; service.go captureNotificationsMiddleware uses client.AddReceivingMiddleware to capture all 7 types in one place — including notifications/cancelled which has no exposed SDK handler; Service interface gained NotificationStream() and AddNotificationObserver(); new tabNotifications (6th tab) in DebugScreen with tab-label count + ⏸ indicator, filter status line, digit-key (1-7) type toggles, 0=clear types, +/-=level threshold, Space/P=pause-resume, x=clear stream, c/y=copy JSON; closure-based notificationsProvider keeps DebugScreen decoupled from concrete service type; --watch-notifications CLI flag installs an observer that writes Entry.FormatLine to stderr per notification; 22 unit tests in notifications package (FromMethod table, AllTypes ordering, LevelRank fallback, Filter type/level branches, FilterEntries order preservation, ring buffer overflow + concurrent Append+Snapshot under -race, pause-drops-and-resume-no-backfill, FormatLine/FormatJSON), 9 translator tests (per-type describeParams + nil request + unknown method + truncate boundaries), 3 service round-trip tests against real in-memory SDK transport (capture all 7 types including cancelled via direct stream Append, observer fires for tools/list_changed, pause affects buffer), 8 TUI tests (no-provider hint, render entries, filter by type, filter by level, pause/resume, tab label count+pause indicator, clear stream), 2 CLI flag tests (off-by-default, observer registers when set). Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: --watch-notifications captured 'tools/listChanged' and 'message [critical]  Critical-level message' to stderr.
